contracts: (S35 verifies every exercised aggregate execution has finite time/output bounds and a deterministic terminal result; an exhausted budget is non-success.) AND (S35 verifies every exercised external-process execution has finite time/output bounds and a deterministic terminal result; an exhausted budget is non-success.)
selector_intents: S35 must fail if an aggregate execution lacks a finite bound or does not produce its required bounded terminal observation.
S35 must fail if an external-process invocation lacks a finite bound or does not produce its required bounded terminal observation.
